notes.title: 'Psychic Kung Fu Master' Test Time, FAQ, and Some Content Leaks
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291904/2f6edcb437daa035e9b8ad0a28707f9fff6f6392.png[/img]

[h2][b]FAQ:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Regarding the Test Version
[/list]
Many players have questioned the test version, thinking it’s an Early Access (EA) version. Let me clarify: Psychic Kung Fu Master's test version is not an EA version, it’s a Playtest version.
The goal of the playtest is to establish the game's tone, evaluate the art style, and check the overall presentation. We will make additions, adjustments, and improvements based on your feedback.

[list]
[*]  Regarding the Test and Demo Time
[/list]
Many players have been asking about the test period, but I’ve hesitated to provide an answer. The original schedule was before the New Year, but after receiving valuable feedback, we decided to rework some resources to improve the overall quality of the game, which caused a delay.
Due to time and personnel limitations, the early test version may not showcase all content.
We will optimize features based on priority, and we truly appreciate the patience of everyone waiting.
The test version is now expected around mid-March. Apologies for the delay!
[list]
[*]  Regarding the Mobile Version
[/list]
Some players have asked if there will be a mobile version. The initial release of Psychic Kung Fu Master will be on the PC version via Steam. There is no mobile version currently available.

[previewyoutube=tOwXPoqOuEg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Leaks:[/b][/h2]
Worldview and Setting:

One of the major factions in Psychic Kung Fu Master is the Dragon Cult (豢龙会).
The Dragon Cult is formed by officials from the wealthy regions of Jiangnan, 
who come together under the leadership of Prince Fu. They have created two groups: one called the Donglin Scholars' Association (东林儒生会), made up of Jiangnan's clans. 
They control the nation's economic lifeblood, financial power, and half of the officials in the court.
In the Jianghu,
 they joined forces with Fang Tieshan to form a faction that consolidates power by controlling local warlords and executing tasks such as assassinations, robberies, and intelligence gathering. This unified force is known as the Dragon Cult.

The Dragon Cult controls dozens of smaller factions in various industries, such as shipping, martial arts schools, escort agencies, bandit leaders, and intelligence organizations. 
The martial arts skills in these factions are diverse and varied. 
They also control numerous officials and some military forces in the court, creating a complex and intricate power structure.

In addition to the Dragon Sect, there are a dozen or so neutral factions that, due to regional or factional issues, are unwilling to have any dealings with the court.

Character Card: Fang Tieshan (Character art not yet released)

[b]Fang Tieshan Introduction:[/b]
Fang Tieshan is the heir to the Fang Xin Martial Arts School. He was originally just an apprentice but, due to his extraordinary martial arts talent, he rose from basic techniques to the highest level of mastery.
Later, he improved the martial arts techniques of his school, advancing even further.

After reaching the top level of martial arts, Fang Tieshan gained fame, and his martial arts schools spread across the land, quietly positioning themselves as one of the most powerful schools in the Central Plains.

Though his reputation as a hero precedes him, his true desire is for power.
He collaborated with the Donglin Scholars' Association and formed the Dragon Cult with the intention of overthrowing the emperor and taking the throne for himself.

[b]Worldview Details:[/b]
Due to the vast world and detailed information, if players are interested in the world-building,
 feel free to leave a comment, and I will share more detailed faction settings next time.
If there's anything specific you'd like to see, feel free to suggest, and I’ll do my best to accommodate!

[url=https://space.bilibili.com/3546733374082009?spm_id_from=333.337.search-card.all.click][/url]

[h2][b]Activities:[/b][/h2]
Lucky Draw:
The lucky draw is always available, and everyone in the group can receive free test codes and participate in early game testing.
All contact information can be found below.

Please don’t forget to add Psychic Kung Fu Master to your Steam Wishlist! Thank you, everyone!

notes.title: today sharing some new character designs and game activities.
notes.content:
Greetings, heroes!
The test version is about to go live, and today we’re sharing some new character designs and game activities.
If you’re interested, please add the game to your Steam wishlist. Thank you all for your support!

[list]
[*] [h1][b]Q&A Section[/b][/h1]
[/list]

Can I build a harem?
Absolutely, that goes without saying!

Can there be more characters to romance?
Our game offers unparalleled freedom—not only can you romance multiple characters, but even NPCs, like the vegetable vendor, are fair game!

Some players want to venture alone, while others prefer companions.
The martial arts world belongs to everyone. It’s your journey, your rules. In Psychic Kung Fu Master, you can travel with companions or fight solo.

Will there be any "cheating" plots?
Rest assured, absolutely not. We understand how frustrating that kind of story can be, and it’s something we avoid completely.

What about the variety of martial arts for the protagonist?
That’s a must-have! Our game is all about one thing—thrill! Just like in our trailer, everything is designed to be as satisfying as possible for players!

We highly value your feedback and will continue selecting the most frequently asked questions for regular updates. Thank you for your support!

[list]
[*] [h1][b]Spoiler Alert:[/b][/h1]
[/list]
Let’s start with showcasing the female characters. Once the test version is live, there will be even more reveals.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45291904/f4b9bb1d7b836bdc7fe38c4e0f00a0d2a7591c82.png[/img]

Additionally, we’ve taken note of all your expectations for the storyline. Rest assured, everything you’re hoping for will be delivered!
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45291904/e99599496ea63f5fbd74a930dee8e37364f8b02f.jpg[/img]


The morality of the martial arts world is in your hands. May you achieve your dreams of justice and vengeance as you roam the world in Psychic Kung Fu Master!
